tools.name: financeCustomerCreate
tools.description: Create a new customer record. USE WHEN you have verified the customer does not already exist. DO NOT USE without first calling financeCustomerSearch to avoid duplicates. Required: name, email. Returns the new customer_id.

tools.name: financeCustomerGet
tools.description: Retrieve a single customer record by exact customer_id. USE WHEN you already know the customer_id. DO NOT USE for lookup by name/email — call financeCustomerSearch instead. Returns the full Customer object including contact fields.

tools.name: financeCustomerSearch
tools.description: Search customers by partial match on name or email. USE WHEN you need to find a customer by descriptive text, or BEFORE creating a new customer to check for duplicates. DO NOT USE for exact id lookup — use financeCustomerGet instead. Returns up to 25 matches ranked by relevance.

q.description: Search query — partial match on customer name or email. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: financeInvoiceCreate
tools.description: Create a new invoice for an existing customer. USE WHEN the customer is already created/verified and you need to bill them. Required: customer_id, amount. Optional: currency (defaults to USD). DOES NOT send the invoice — only persists it in 'draft' status.

tools.name: financeInvoiceGet
tools.description: Retrieve a single invoice by exact invoice_id. USE WHEN you have a specific invoice_id and need its full detail (line items, status, amount, customer reference). DO NOT USE for browsing or filtering — use financeInvoiceList.

tools.name: financeInvoiceList
tools.description: List invoices with optional filters: customer_id (scope to one customer) and/or status (one of: draft, sent, paid, overdue). USE WHEN browsing or reporting. DO NOT USE when you already have a specific invoice_id — use financeInvoiceGet. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at desc.

customer_id.description: Optional. Restrict results to invoices for a single customer (e.g. 'c-001').

status.description: Optional. Filter by invoice status. One of: 'draft', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue'.

tools.name: financePaymentApprove
tools.description: Approve payment release for an existing invoice. USE WHEN a human or upstream workflow has authorized payment. Required: invoice_id, approver. Idempotent: re-approving an already-approved invoice returns the existing approval. DOES NOT execute the payment — downstream payment-rails tool is responsible.

approver.description: Identifier of the user or system authorizing the payment (e.g. an email or service principal name).

invoice_id.description: Identifier of the invoice to approve for payment.

tools.name: financeQuoteGet
tools.description: Get the current market quote (bid/ask/last) for a ticker symbol. USE WHEN you need real-time pricing for a decision. Symbol format: uppercase ticker, e.g. MSFT. Quotes are advisory only — they are NOT execution prices and may be stale up to 250ms.
